analysis.subject: physics
analysis.pageCoverage: Page covers factors affecting lift, how lift coefficient simplifies complex dependencies, the lift equation relating lift to coefficient, density, velocity and wing area, and notes on determining the coefficient and naming of density and dynamic pressure.

overview.headline: Lift equation linking lift to density, speed, area and coefficient

keyPoints.point: Lift depends on air density, velocity, viscosity and compressibility among other factors.
keyPoints.quote: Lift depends on the density of the air, the square of the velocity, the air's viscosity and compressibility

keyPoints.point: Lift coefficient designated Cl provides a single variable to capture complex dependencies.
keyPoints.quote: For lift, this variable is called the lift coefficient, designated "Cl."

keyPoints.point: Lift equals lift coefficient times density rho times half velocity squared times wing area.
keyPoints.quote: lift L is equal to the lift coefficient Cl times the density rho times half of the velocity V squared times the wing area A

keyPoints.point: For simple flow conditions and geometries at low inclinations the coefficient can be determined mathematically.
keyPoints.quote: For some simple flow conditions and geometries and low inclinations, aerodynamicists can determine the value of Cl mathematically.

keyTerms.gloss: Force generated by air flowing over a surface that depends on density and velocity.
keyTerms.quote: Lift depends on the density of the air, the square of the velocity, the air's viscosity and compressibility

keyTerms.gloss: Single variable that collects complex dependence on shape, inclination, viscosity and compressibility.
keyTerms.quote: For lift, this variable is called the lift coefficient, designated "Cl."

keyTerms.gloss: Mass per volume of air designated by rho in the lift equation.
keyTerms.quote: In the equation given above, the density is designated by the letter rho.

keyTerms.gloss: Combination of density times velocity squared divided by two that appears in Bernoulli pressure relation.
keyTerms.quote: The combination of terms "density times the square of the velocity divided by two" is called the dynamic pressure

keyTerms.gloss: Property of air related to viscosity that influences lift dependence on flow conditions.
keyTerms.quote: Lift depends on the density of the air, the square of the velocity, the air's viscosity and compressibility

componentPlan.pedagogicalReason: Lets students manipulate coefficient, density, speed and area to see proportional effects on lift in the stated equation.
Reinforces recall of vocabulary for density symbol, dynamic pressure and experimental determination of coefficient.
componentPlan.focusQuote: The combination of terms "density times the square of the velocity divided by two" is called the dynamic pressure
